question: What property taxes may apply to this transaction, ownership or transfer?
guardrails: Do not infer tax liability from property value alone.
Tax treatment depends on transaction type, parties, consideration/value, dates, property use and applicable reliefs/exemptions.
Do not mix Stamp Duty, LPT, CGT and CAT into a single generic property tax.
Tax calculations must use the law and rates applicable on the relevant date.
Do not treat a tax clearance or payment as proof of title or planning compliance.
Flag accountant/tax-adviser review for complex transactions, companies, trusts, development activity or uncertain residence/domicile issues.
